creative_direction: Create a dry gravel court with one low stone and a maple shadow. The maple tree stays outside the frame, visible only through a soft red-tinted leaf edge and its shadow. Raked gravel lines curve gently around the stone without becoming a diagram. A plain plaster wall fills the upper fifth with quiet light. Keep the composition restrained, with no figures, lanterns, or text. Use minimal garden painting. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
